label: Represents e r: the episode e presents the perfection r as its content (an idea's objective reality)
definition: `IdeaFrame.Represents e r` holds when the episode e presents the perfection r as its content: e is an idea of r, and r is the idea's objective reality (what the idea is of), as an idea of heat presents heat. Representing r is not having r (the idea of heat is not hot, so Represents e r does not give InAct e r), not being caused to have r, and not representing truly: Represents e r does not say that anything has r. It is a primitive field of the idea frame; nothing relates it to Occurs, Bears, ObjCause or to any field of the grades frame.
note: Analyst stipulation, attribution deferred (navigation: Descartes, Meditation III, 'objective reality' of an idea as against its formal reality as a mode of thought). Example: a thought of the sun represents the sun's heat and size whether or not the sun exists. Counterexample: an occurring episode of pain represents nothing on the narrow reading; this record does not decide whether every episode represents something. Distinguished from the frame's InAct (having a perfection) and from CogitoSubject.Bears (bearing an episode). Open obligations: no law fixes which perfections an episode can represent, whether representation of r requires any grasp of r, or whether an idea of the infinite can be formed by negating a limit (the objection recorded in attempt 7e8fcf16, which targets the adequacy premise, not this primitive).
